name: git-safety
description: Local git-workflow safety for Claude Code: stage explicit paths, re-check the tree before commit and push, never discard a dirty tree, author and push identity, and the hazards of several sessions or a file syncer sharing one working tree. One PreToolUse hook spots risky git commands (reset --hard, clean -f, force push, remote deletes, branch -D, history rewrites). By default it reminds Claude after the command runs; the opt-in ask mode makes you confirm irreversible operations before they run.

guard_mode.title: Guard mode
guard_mode.description: advise (default): remind Claude after a risky git command runs. ask: you confirm irreversible git operations before they run. off: hook does nothing. The GIT_SAFETY_MODE environment variable overrides this.
